title: GeneRead QIAact Lung DNA UMI Panel Kit: Cleanup of Adapter-ligated DNA with QIAact Beads
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol automates the third part of a seven part protocol for the [GeneRead QIAact Lung DNA UMI Panel Kit](https://www.qiagen.com/us/products/instruments-and-automation/genereader-system/generead-qiaact-lung-panels-ww/) which constructs molecularly bar-coded DNA libraries for digital sequencing. This protocol automates the Cleanup of Adapter-ligated DNA with QIAact Beads part described in the [GeneRead QIAact Lung DNA UMI Panel Handbook](https://www.qiagen.com/us/resources/download.aspx?id=94ab92d2-1918-4388-989b-4cefa8eed203&lang=en). * Part 1: [Fragmentation, End-repair and A-addition](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/6d7fc3) * Part 2: [Adapter Ligation](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/6d7fc3-part-2) * Part 3: [Cleanup of Adapter-ligated DNA with QIAact Beads.](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/6d7fc3-part-3) * Part 4: [Target Enrichment PCR](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/6d7fc3-part-4) * Part 5: [Cleanup of Target Enrichment PCR with QIAact Beads](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/6d7fc3-part-5) * Part 6: [Universal PCR Amplification.](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/6d7fc3-part-6) * Part 7: [Cleanup of Universal PCR with QIAact Beads](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/6d7fc3-part-7) Explanation of complex parameters below: * `Number of Samples`: The total number of DNA samples. Samples must range between 1 (minimum) and 12 (maximum). * `P300 Single GEN2 Pipette Mount Position`: The position of the pipette, either left or right. * `P20 Single GEN2 Pipette Mount Position`: The position of the pipette, either left or right. * `Magnetic Module Engage Height (mm)`: The height the magnets should raise. ---
Completely remove residual supernatant from magnet plate.

steps.title: Transfer adapter ligation reaction
steps.instruction: Transfer 50 µL of the Adapter Ligation Reaction into a well of the Magnetic Module Plate.

steps.title: Adjust volume with water
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL nuclease‑free water to the well to bring the total volume to 100 µL.

steps.title: Add QIAact beads
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL QIAact Beads to the DNA mixture on the Magnetic Module Plate and mix gently.

steps.title: Incubate binding reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Bind beads on magnet
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module for 10 minutes to capture the beads.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant without disturbing the beads, then remove any residual liquid completely.

steps.title: Ethanol wash beads
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of 80 % ethanol to the beads, remove the ethanol, and repeat the wash once more.

steps.title: Centrifuge plate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample plate briefly to collect any remaining liquid.

steps.title: Final bead drying
steps.instruction: Engage the magnet for 2 minutes, remove any residual supernatant, then air‑dry the beads for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Elute DNA (first)
steps.instruction: Add 52 µL nuclease‑free water to the beads to elute DNA and mix gently.

steps.title: Collect eluate
steps.instruction: Engage the magnet for 5 minutes, then place a new NEST 96‑well deep‑well plate in Slot 4.

steps.title: Transfer eluate to new plate
steps.instruction: Transfer 50 µL of the supernatant from the magnetic plate to the new deep‑well plate in Slot 4.

steps.title: Add beads for second cleanup
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL QIAact beads to the well containing the transferred eluate.

steps.title: Incubate second binding
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Bind beads on magnet (second)
steps.instruction: Remove the original deep‑well plate from the magnetic module, replace it with the new plate from Slot 4, and engage the magnet for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Remove supernatant (second)
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant from the magnetic plate, then remove any residual liquid completely.

steps.title: Ethanol wash beads (second)
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of 80 % ethanol, remove it, and repeat the wash once more.

steps.title: Centrifuge and reposition plate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the magnetic plate briefly, then place it back on the magnetic module.

steps.title: Final drying (second)
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module for 2 minutes, remove any residual supernatant, and air‑dry the beads for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Elute DNA (second)
steps.instruction: Add 22 µL nuclease‑free water to the beads, mix thoroughly 5 times to elute DNA.

steps.title: Collect final eluate
steps.instruction: Engage the magnet for 5 minutes, then transfer 9.4 µL of the supernatant into each Forward and Reverse Enrichment PCR tube.
